SELECT t.product_category_name_english, round(sum(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING (product_id) JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) m, count(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY 1) SELECT m, n, lag(n) OVER (ORDER BY m) AS prev FROM monthly
SELECT seller_id, price, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY price DESC) FROM order_items
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FROM order_items
SELECT avg(review_score) FROM order_reviews WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered')
SELECT customer_state, count(*) FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 100
SELECT CASE WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN 'good' ELSE 'bad' END AS bucket, count(*) FROM order_reviews GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.review_id IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT customer_state FROM customers ORDER BY 1
